name: Bitterroot River (Stevensville)
blurb: Gentle valley float with Bitterroot peaks for a backdrop. Infamous for shifting logjams.

sections.notes: Channels braid and wood moves every year — heads-up floating.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP — John & Nancy Owen Fishing Access Site
takeOutAccess.note: FWP documents boating access at this facility. The site coordinate and March 2026 boundary map locate the access area, not a surveyed ramp edge. FWP’s June 2026 announcement describes the gravel launch and expanded trailer parking; the GIS boat-facility attribute has not caught up.
takeOutAccess.directions: From US 93, take Stevensville Cutoff Road east about ¼ mile. Enter the signed John & Nancy Owen FAS on the north side of the road; use the designated launch, not the highway bridge.

sections.notes: Check recent obstruction reports — strainers are common here.
